name: Alien Musc Mystérieux
remarks: Launched April 2017 as part of the Alien Oriental Collection next to Alien Oud Majestueux (2015). NST (read) gives EDP 90 ml, woody oriental, notes saffron, white musk, jasmine, cashmeran wood, vanilla. Ropion credit comes from retailer and blog listings found by search, not from the page read. Jasmine is jasmine sambac. Current availability unclear.

name: Rêve d'Infini
remarks: LuxSB (read) gives perfumer Richard Ibanez and a flat note list: bergamot, litchi, white roses, jasmine, rose, nectar, freesia, peach, cedar, vanilla, musk, sandalwood. Pyramid distributed by us. One retailer (Macy's) credits Nathalie Lorson instead; Ibanez is the more repeated credit. Year 2015 from retailer listings.

name: Lady Emblem Elixir
remarks: Flanker of Lady Emblem (2015). Review read lists mandarin, lychee, black peppercorn; iris, bitter citrus blossom, damask rose; vanilla, patchouli, sandalwood. Rose gold faceted bottle. Year 2016 from retailer listings. Perfumer not found.

name: Sporty Citrus
remarks: Osmoz (read): 2013, Honorine Blanc (Firmenich), family Citrus Aromatic. Brand copy also mentions a touch of cassis.

name: N°19 Poudré
remarks: Launched 19 August 2011 (Coco Chanel's birthday). Prime Beauté (read): Grasse neroli, mandarin, Persian galbanum; jasmine absolute, iris pallida; white musks, Haitian vetiver, tonka. Family floral powdery green. Early articles say EDT but the bottle sold is labelled Eau de Parfum (commenters on both pages). Sheldrake co-credit from his interviews at launch. Current availability in some markets unclear.

name: Éclat de Fleurs
remarks: Announced for July 2015, reviewed by NST in Feb 2016 (read): pear dominant, freesia, rose, jasmine sambac, near-transparent white musk, sandalwood; aldehydic fizz. Ball-shaped bottle echoing Arpège with ribbed petal pattern. Top tier has a single note (pear accord).

name: In New York
remarks: Le-parfum.fr (read): 2016, aromatic with fougère facet, inspired by the Fifth Avenue boutique; heart lavender and clary sage, base ambery woods and tonka; top described as lemon, mandarin, marine notes (official top tier marked 'coming soon', so top inferred). Square grey thick-glass bottle. Several retailers say discontinued. Perfumer not found.

name: Midnight Rain
remarks: Osmoz (read): 2006, EDP, Floral Fruity. 'Plum' is plum blossom and 'Amber' stands for 'amber flower' in the heart. Retailers describe it as discontinued and scarce. Perfumer not published.

name: L'Eau Majeure d'Issey
remarks: Perfume Society (read): EDT, citrus cocktail of bergamot and grapefruit, salty accord heart, woody base with cashmeran. Year 2017 from retailer listings; flanker L'Eau Super Majeure d'Issey followed in 2018. Heart is a single 'salty accord', mapped to Sea Salt. Perfumer not confirmed (Ropion credit unverified).

name: Imagine
remarks: Identity unclear: search results mix a 2019 'Imagine' (Les Parisiennes), a 2022/2024 limited EDP and an 'L'Art & La Matière' listing with a different pyramid. The only page read (vivir.com) looks unreliable. Skipped.

name: Man in Black Cologne
remarks: Likely 'Bvlgari Man Black Cologne' (2016, Morillas), but many retailers use 'Man In Black Cologne' for the 2014 Man In Black EDP. Could not read any page confirming this product (403/429 on all fetches). Skipped.

name: La Nuit de L'Homme Eau Électrique
perfumer: Juliette Karagueuzoglou, Dominique Ropion, Anne Flipo
remarks: Perfume N Cologne (read): 2017, EDT, three perfumers; bergamot, mandarin, green apple; orange blossom absolute, aromatic sage, fougère accord of lavender, geranium, tonka; cedar, cashmere woods, vetiver, patchouli, vanilla. Out of stock at retailers; not to be confused with Bleu Électrique (2021). Discontinued status inferred from retail availability.

name: Tome 1 La Pureté for Her
remarks: Le-parfum.fr (read): 2012, floral with woody musk facet; heart almond note and jasmine tea; base tonka, Tonkin musk, sandalwood; top marked 'coming soon'. Top taken from the 2009 unisex original's published notes (bergamot, orange flower), hence inferred. Nathalie Lorson credit from retailer listings. Concentration per hint; not confirmed on the page read.

name: Wanted Girl Tonic
remarks: WikiScents and MaxAroma (both read): 2020, kiwi and ginger; acai berry and datura; bamboo wood and tonka. Brand copy (via retailers) cites lemon ginger, acai berry, bamboo. Created at IFF; individual perfumers not confirmed. Flanker of Wanted Girl (2019).

name: The One Gold
remarks: Full name The One Gold Eau de Parfum Intense. Official page and Nordstrom (both read) give only plum, rose, jasmine, floral fruity, gold lacquer bottle. Mandarin, pink pepper, patchouli, vanilla, white musk from retailer listings seen in search. Year 2021 from retailer listings. Perfumer credit conflicting, left null.

name: La Panthère Légère
remarks: Full name La Panthère Eau de Parfum Légère, spring 2015 flanker of La Panthère (2014). Perfume Society (read): musk-gardenia accord with tiaré flower, chypre family, clear unfrosted bottle. Pyramid from The Perfume Girl listing seen in search. Mathilde Laurent is Cartier's in-house perfumer and authored La Panthère.

name: Boss The Scent Intense for Her
remarks: Official name Boss The Scent For Her Intense. Review read: EDP, honeyed peach, osmanthus absolute, vanilla, cocoa; sweet and warm, about seven hours. Freesia from WikiParfum listing. Pyramid arranged by us following retailer listings. Year 2017 from retailers. Perfumer credit unclear.

name: Mi Fa
remarks: NST 2008 (read): EDP 100 ml, Jacques Flori with the late Zoé Coste, centred on marshmallow; launched with Do Re in the Les Notes Gourmandes line. ScentBase (read) gives the pyramid (also lavender, rosemary, orange; amber in base). Gender from ScentBase community rating, not from the brand.

name: For Her Amber Musc
remarks: Affinez (read): 2013, Aurélien Guichard, EDP, Amber family. Part of the For Her musc collection. Benlux gives a differently ordered pyramid with the same materials.

name: Bottega Veneta pour Homme Essence Aromatique
remarks: Osmoz and NST (both read): 2016, EDC 50/90/200 ml, Amandine Marie (Clerc-Marie). Masculine counterpart to Essence Aromatique (2014). Pine is Siberian pine. Some retailers list cedar in base.
